changelog: v178: fix(167): content-first close — the builder reads the conversation, starved closes refuse (ADR 0015). Two owner-hit live incidents in two days, one audited root cause: build_closing_prompt() had never seen the conversation — it read only mode + rolling_summary, a field the hosted platform never writes and that, even when written, never contained the message being replied to. Every model-generated close was starved: first as confabulation (#163's invented "you pushed back" claim), then, post-#164's format fix, as an honest description of emptiness delivered to a person who had just written a three-hundred-word memory (the 2026-08-16 platform incident). Fix A: build_closing_prompt() now assembles a real transcript — the FINAL USER TURN verbatim, never truncated away regardless of length or budget (it is the reason a reply is owed), preceded by recent turns within the new budget.closing_transcript knob (interaction.yaml, default 1200 tokens, oldest turns yielding first when the window is tight), plus rolling_summary when non-empty as older context the window dropped. Fix B: the builder now RAISES (conversation.ConversationPromptError, a new ConversationError-family member) when the session has no user turns AND no non-empty rolling summary — it never emits a prompt asking a model to appreciate nothing. The engine (conversation_delivery._deliver_closing) degrades per a two-class table keyed on close_session_now's own close reason: a live, budget-reached closing beat (reason done/exit_taken) falls back to an ORDINARY question-free turn via conversation.build_turn_prompt — the person gets a real reply and the close itself is deferred, the session stays open ("the thread lands another day"); a sweep/idle/day close (reason idle_timeout/day_rollover, SWEEP_CLOSE_REASONS) degrades to the existing silence path — the session still closes cleanly, nothing is sent. close_session_now() now honors _deliver_closing's starved_fallback_turn detail by returning without closing the session. Fix E: behavior.md rule 8 gains a prime-directive opening ("this surface speaks only about the author's own content, to the author — a turn with no content to speak about is silence, not invention") plus a respond-first clause (a close responds to the final message first, the same receipt and payout an ordinary turn would give it, before settling into the takeaway — "a close that ignores what was just said is a defect"); build_closing_prompt()'s own instruction checklist carries the same rewrite. The handbook's byte-exact embed (docs/handbook/interactions/conversation.md) moved in the same commit, verified via tests/test_handbook_parity.py's EmbedParityTests (version reference bumped to v178). context/manifest.md documents the closing-prompt assembly as its own section (separate from the per-turn assemble_context recipe it doesn't share). Fix D: one new golden PASS, chat-seattle-ferry-closing.json — a several-hundred-word final user message (the incident's own shape) that the closing turn visibly engages — declaring a NEW golden property id, closing_engages_final_message (system/interaction_evals.py, checked via distinctive-token overlap between the closing text and the final user turn, a concrete verifiable signal per the contract's "keep the checker honest and simple" instruction). FLAGGED: this is a new property id — the platform's closed-vocabulary reconciliation is due at the next pin bump. New tests/test_content_first_close.py (25 tests): the final user turn is verbatim and unbudgeted; budget.closing_transcript truncates earlier turns oldest-first; rolling_summary inclusion; the starvation guard raises on every no-content shape (no turns key, empty turns, lifehug-only turns) and never raises when either a user turn or a rolling summary alone is present; the CLI refuses an empty-session build cleanly (exit 1, one stderr line); both engine degradation classes end-to-end via _deliver_closing (budget-beat -> ordinary reply sent, session stays open; sweep -> silence, session stays open for the caller to actually close) plus close_session_now's own starved_fallback_turn wiring; the closing_engages_final_message checker's pass/fail/wrong-kind cases; the committed Seattle golden passes check_golden whole. conversation.py's CLI prompt-builder wrapper now catches the full ConversationError family (was OSError/ValueError/KeyError only), so a starved closing-prompt CLI call degrades to a clean "Error: ..." + exit 1 instead of an unhandled traceback. Zero platform code touched (out of scope, ADR 0015 records the pin-bump riders: the platform's REPLAY subprocess path inherits the fix automatically, plus the vocabulary reconciliation and the blocking-posture/regression-test riders). Full suite zero delta vs. the pre-existing 21-failure environment baseline; conversation-evals keyless layers green; EmbedParityTests green.
